_comment: LAYER 2 — service pricing for the FICTIONAL Aura Salon & Spa demo. DUMMY / PLACEHOLDER values only. Mirrors data/canopy_commercial.json's is_dummy convention. The agent must ALWAYS speak these as indicative, confirmed by the front desk — never as a final bill.
